model.role: general multimodal model prompted for nested line and word geometry

prompt:
You are annotating handwriting geometry, NOT transcribing or correcting it. Detect every visible PUPIL-HANDWRITTEN text line and every handwritten word on this notebook image. Ignore paper ruling, printed notebook elements, red margin rules, drawings, and wholly blank areas. Different ink colours may all belong to the pupil; exclude handwriting only when the image itself makes teacher authorship clear. Return ONLY one compact JSON object, no markdown, with normalized 0..1000 nested line and word boxes.The JSON object must have exactly this shape:
{"lines":[{"bbox_2d":[x1,y1,x2,y2],"words":[{"bbox_2d":[x1,y1,x2,y2]}]}],"excluded_visible_handwriting":[{"bbox_2d":[x1,y1,x2,y2],"reason":"brief reason"}]}

Rules:
- Coordinates are integers normalized to 0..1000 relative to the full image, origin at top-left.
- Each line box covers one complete handwritten row, including short headings, dates, and margin notes when written by the pupil.
- Each word box tightly covers one separate handwritten word or token and belongs inside its parent line box.
- Do not merge adjacent rows. Do not invent boxes for ruling, blank space, or printed elements.
- Do not transcribe, explain, count, or add any keys beyond the two shown above.
metrics_note: Canonical line and whitespace-token counts come from the verified notebook transcript. Count error is not geometry accuracy. ReadingPipeline comparison is symmetric Dice agreement after greedy matching at IoU >= 0.25; it is cross-detector consistency, not box truth, because no human-drawn box ground truth exists. One page-3 response omitted one closing square bracket inside a bbox array; the original response is preserved and one deterministic syntax repair was applied before structural validation. No model call was retried or selected by score.

json_repair.rule: Inserted a missing closing square bracket before a bbox_2d object close; original response remains in raw_response.
